description: This PHP script manages parental control services, including adding, editing, deleting services, and configuring managed services settings. It handles port testing, time conflict detection, and updates device configuration via setStr/getStr functions.

methods.name: PORTTEST
methods.description: Checks if given ports overlap within specified port ranges.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Determines if two time/date blocks conflict based on overlapping days and times.
